title: ASI as the New God: Technocratic Theocracy
reasoning: The entire paper is a philosophical and theological analysis comparing Artificial Superintelligence (ASI) to divine attributes found in religions (omnipotence, omniscience, etc.). It explores the ethical risks of human abdication of agency to AI systems and the potential emergence of a 'technocratic theocracy,' specifically discussing religious frameworks, moral authority, and utilitarian ethics.
